resources.name: ssh-keys
resources.description: You can add SSH keys to your account, which can be copied to new instances when first deployed. Updating a key does not update any running instances. If you reinstall an instance (erasing all its data), it will inherit the updated key.

operations.description: Get information about an SSH Key.

operations.name: update-ssh-key
operations.description: Update an SSH Key. The attributes name and ssh_key are optional. If not set, the attributes will retain their original values. New deployments will use the updated key, but this action does not update previously deployed instances.

parameters.name: ssh-key-id
parameters.description: The SSH Key id.

resources.name: instances
resources.description: Vultr Cloud instances can be deployed with your preferred operating system or pre-installed application in seconds. High Frequency Compute instances are powered by high clock speed CPU's and NVMe local storage to power your most demanding applications. Dedicated Cloud instances have dedicated CPU, SSD drives, and RAM.

operations.name: create-instance
operations.description: Create a new VPS Instance in a region with the desired plan. Choose one of the following to deploy the instance: os_id, iso_id, snapshot_id, app_id, image_id.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The Region id where the Instance is located.

parameters.name: plan
parameters.description: The Plan id to use when deploying this instance.

parameters.name: os_id
parameters.description: The Operating System id to use when deploying this instance.

parameters.name: ipxe_chain_url
parameters.description: The URL location of the iPXE chainloader.

parameters.name: iso_id
parameters.description: The ISO id to use when deploying this instance.

parameters.name: script_id
parameters.description: The Startup Script id to use when deploying this instance.

parameters.name: snapshot_id
parameters.description: The Snapshot id to use when deploying the instance.

parameters.name: enable_ipv6
parameters.description: Enable IPv6.

parameters.name: disable_public_ipv4
parameters.description: Don't set up a public IPv4 address when IPv6 is enabled. Will not do anything unless enable_ipv6 is also true.

parameters.name: attach_vpc
parameters.description: An array of VPC IDs to attach to this Instance. This parameter takes precedence over enable_vpc. Please choose one parameter.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: A user-supplied label for this instance.

parameters.name: sshkey_id
parameters.description: The SSH Key id to install on this instance.

parameters.name: backups
parameters.description: Enable automatic backups for the instance (does not work for VX1 block storage).

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: The Application id to use when deploying this instance.

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: The Application image_id to use when deploying this instance.

parameters.name: user_data
parameters.description: The user-supplied, base64 encoded user data to attach to this instance.

parameters.name: ddos_protection
parameters.description: Enable DDoS protection (there is an additional charge for this).

parameters.name: activation_email
parameters.description: Notify by email after deployment.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The hostname to use when deploying this instance.

parameters.name: firewall_group_id
parameters.description: The Firewall Group id to attach to this Instance.

parameters.name: reserved_ipv4
parameters.description: ID of the floating IP to use as the main IP of this server.

parameters.name: enable_vpc
parameters.description: If true, VPC support will be added to the new server. This parameter attaches a single VPC. When no VPC exists in the region, it will be automatically created. If there are multiple VPCs in the instance's region, use attach_vpc instead to specify a network.

parameters.name: vpc_only
parameters.description: If true, this VPS will not receive a public IP or public NIC. A vpc_id will be required in the attach_vpc array. The first vpc_id provided must have a NAT Gateway attached. This VPS will gain access to the internet via the NAT Gateway attached to the VPC.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags to apply to the instance.

parameters.name: user_scheme
parameters.description: Linux-only: The user scheme used for logging into this instance. By default, the "root" user is configured. Alternatively, a limited user with sudo permissions can be selected.

parameters.name: app_variables
parameters.description: The app variable inputs for configuring the marketplace app (name/value pairs).

parameters.name: instance-id
parameters.description: The Instance ID.
